hero.title: About Nidal Al-Rouh
hero.subtitle: A safe, accessible, and culturally sensitive digital space where no Moroccan faces mental health struggles alone

mission.title: Our Mission & Vision
mission.description: Born from lived experience with bipolar disorder, Nidal Al-Rouh is a personal and community-driven initiative to build a non-profit, open-source mental health support platform designed for Moroccan individuals facing mental health challenges.
mission.founded: Founded in 2025 by a Moroccan developer living with mental health challenges

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.quote: A safe, accessible, and culturally sensitive digital space where no Moroccan faces mental health struggles alone.
vision.meaning: "Nidal Al-Rouh" means "the struggle of the soul" or "the journey of the soul" — acknowledging the inner battle while celebrating the resilience that lives within each of us.

values.title: Our Core Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide our mission to support the Moroccan community

compassion.title: Community & Empathy
compassion.description: Creating safe spaces where every Moroccan can share their journey without judgment, fostering genuine connections and mutual support.

privacy.title: Privacy & Trust
privacy.description: Your anonymity and confidentiality are sacred to us. We understand the cultural sensitivity around mental health in Morocco.

accessibility.title: Accessibility & Inclusion
accessibility.description: Mental health support should be available to everyone, regardless of financial means or social circumstances.

empowerment.title: Awareness & Empowerment
empowerment.description: Breaking the silence and stigma through education, peer support, and community-driven change.

targetUsers.title: Who We Serve
targetUsers.subtitle: Supporting those who need it most in our community

primary.title: People Seeking Support
items: Individuals living with depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety, or other challenges
People who cannot afford psychiatric care
Those feeling isolated or unable to speak openly about their struggles
Individuals looking for culturally sensitive resources and guidance

secondary.title: Support Providers
items: Mental health NGOs and associations in Morocco
Community organizers facilitating activities and meetups

phases.title: Our Development Journey
phases.subtitle: Building a comprehensive platform step by step

phase1.title: Phase 1: Foundation (Current)
phase1.description: Safe Start - MVP with peer support, educational resources, and crisis directory

phase2.title: Phase 2: Growth & Support
phase2.description: Expanding with professional support and tracking features

phase3.title: Phase 3: Scaling & Empowerment
phase3.description: Advanced features and mobile app launch

cultural.title: Cultural Considerations
cultural.subtitle: Designed specifically for the Moroccan context
items: Deep understanding of mental health stigma in Moroccan society
Bilingual support (Arabic/French/English) with potential Darija integration
Community-oriented design reflecting Moroccan values of solidarity
Collaboration with local NGOs and religious/community leaders

openSource.title: Open Source & Community
openSource.description: This platform is more than code — it's about breaking silence, building trust, and healing together.
approach: Clear contribution guidelines respecting cultural sensitivity
Protection of anonymity and privacy in all contributions
Encouraging Moroccan developers, designers, and NGOs to collaborate
Building a community around shared mission, not just code

team.title: Our Team & Community
team.subtitle: A grassroots initiative growing into a community-driven platform

founder.title: Founded by Experience
founder.description: Started by a Moroccan developer living with bipolar disorder, this platform represents authentic understanding of mental health struggles in our community.

team.joinDescription: We're building a community of developers, mental health professionals, and advocates who believe no one should face mental health challenges alone.

contribute.title: How to Contribute
items: Volunteer as a mental health professional
Share your story to reduce stigma
Connect us with Moroccan NGOs and organizations
